closure_audit.title: Recent advances in sensitive and rapid PFOA determination based on sensing strategies: Status, challenge, and prospect
closure_audit.rationale: 官网完整原摘要把AI-aided data optimization明确列为future directions，已描述的综述贡献是PFOA光学/电化学识别探针和信号机制；可见导论/结论片段未提供既有AI模型的实质研究综合。按现有证据不纳，不把2027年被引文献或推荐文章当本篇AI贡献。
closure_audit.official_original_abstract: Perfluorooctanoic acid (PFOA), a representative per- and polyfluoroalkyl substance (PFAS), is widely used in industrial coatings, food packaging, and fire-fighting foams. PFOA exhibits high persistence and bioaccumulation, leading to ubiquitous presence in global environment such as water, soil, organisms and posing hepatotoxic, immunosuppressive, and carcinogenic risks to humans. Thus, fast and efficient PFOA detection is of critical importance and significance. Traditional analytical methods like LC-MS/MS offer high accuracy but require complex sample pretreatment, expensive equipment, and skilled personnel, limiting the on-site use. Sensor-based technologies have emerged as ideal alternatives due to their high sensitivity, rapid response, simple operation, and portability. This review systematically summarizes recent advances in sensor-based PFOA detection, classifying sensors into optical (i.e., colorimetric, fluorometric), electrochemical, and others (like SERS, capillary flow). Key recognition probes, including molecularly imprinted polymers (MIPs), aptamers, and metal organic frameworks (MOFs) are emphasized for various sensors, with details on their sensing performance, mechanism, and signal transduction. At last, future directions including multifunctional sensing array platforms, biomimetic recognition integration, portable device industrialization, and AI-aided data optimization are proposed, aiming to advance reliable PFOA monitoring in the environment.

closure_audit.title: Emerging SERS strategies for highly polar organophosphorus pesticides in environmental and food-agricultural products
closure_audit.rationale: 官网完整原摘要将machine-learning-assisted spectral interpretation明确定位未来方向，正文可见部分的实质综合为吸附、热点、基底工程和分析验证；没有可核实的既有AI研究综合，不以引用或未来愿景纳入。
closure_audit.official_original_abstract: Highly polar organophosphorus pesticides, especially glyphosate-related compounds, present critical challenges to global food safety, yet their trace detection is severely hindered by inherent physicochemical properties that result in weak interfacial adsorption on conventional noble metal substrates. In this review, recent breakthrough advancements in surface-enhanced Raman scattering (SERS) technology dedicated to the sensing of these analytes are summarized. The fundamental mechanisms governing interfacial adsorption thermodynamics and plasmonic hot spot configurations are comprehensively elucidated, which provides a solid theoretical foundation for the panoramic evaluation of advanced material engineering. The evolution of advanced substrate engineering toward electromagnetic hot spot intensification and chemical enhancement is critically examined, alongside strategies for enhancing the affinity between analyte and substrate through surface functionalization, derivatization, signal transduction mediated by nanozymes, and aptamer recognition as well as multimodal integration for reducing false positive results. Practical aspects encompassing sample pretreatment protocols, calibration matched to matrix composition, and methodological validation are discussed. Finally, future directions involving microfluidic automation, spectral interpretation assisted by machine learning, and standardized reporting protocols are outlined. It is emphasized that SERS is best positioned as a complementary triage and screening tool that alleviates the burden on confirmatory chromatographic methods rather than serving as their universal replacement, with practical translation contingent upon robust specificity, reproducible substrates, and transparent validation against realistic matrices.

closure_audit.title: Nanocomposite based electrochemical aptasensors for the detection of Cd2+, Pb2+ and Hg2+ in food and water: Recent trends and future perspectives
closure_audit.rationale: 官网完整原摘要及Introduction均把AI数据分析列为prospective/future directions；已综述内容为重金属适配体筛选、电极纳米复合材料及检测表现。AI仅未来方案不足以构成现有科学AI研究综合，按当前证据不纳。
closure_audit.official_original_abstract: Heavy metal ions (HMIs) contamination in food and water is a serious threat to global food security and human health. Detecting HMIs with high specificity, sensitivity and accuracy is a challenging task. Although traditional analytical methods are accurate and sensitive, they are expensive, pretreatment is complex and lack portability for on-site detection. Specific, accurate, sensitive and rapid methods are of significant importance for real-time detection of HMIs. Nanocomposite-based electrochemical aptasensors technology is a promising candidate for detection of HMIs, due to its high specificity, sensitivity, flexibility and accuracy. This review focuses on recent advances in the development of electrochemical aptasensors for detection of HMIs, mainly cadmium (Cd2+), lead (Pb2+) and mercury (Hg2+) ions in food and water from 2020 to 2026. First, methods for the screening and isolation of aptamers were described, followed by a basic assessment of HMI electrochemical sensing. Then, research progress on electrochemical aptasensors for the detection of HMIs with various materials-modified electrodes, including aptamers and carbon (graphene and reduced graphene oxide), metal (AuNPs) and metal-organic framework (Cu-MOF, UiO-66-MOF, Ce-MOF and Fe-MOF)-based nanocomposites, was introduced systematically. The drawbacks of aptamers and nanocomposites have been presented in detail. In addition, the current challenges associated with nanocomposite-based electrochemical aptasensors applications, including multianalyte detection and performance in complex food matrices, have been critically examined. Furthermore, prospective research directions include the demand for sustainable materials to increase performance and accessibility, improved analytical properties, enhanced aptasensors shelf life, and artificial intelligence-driven data analysis. This review will help improve awareness of the role that nanocomposite-based electrochemical aptasensor can play in protecting our food and water from HMIs toxicants.
